props.name: source
props.description: The Markdown text. `children` works too when it is a string.

props.name: title
props.description: A header title such as README.md. Without one (and without `showSource`) there is no frame.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Scroll the body past this height.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the border and header. Defaults to true when there is no title or switch.

examples.setup:
const readme = `# Display primitives

Small, **dependency-free** pieces for showing files: *PDF*, _Markdown_, SVG,
video, audio and JSON. See [the gallery](/gallery) or https://jayrr.dev.

## Install

\`\`\`bash
npx shadcn add @jayrr/markdown-display
\`\`\`

## What it renders

- Headings, paragraphs and \`inline code\`
- **Bold**, *italic* and ~~strikethrough~~
- Nested lists
  1. ordered
  2. and unordered
- Tables, quotes and rules

> Raw HTML is never rendered, and \`javascript:\` links are dropped.

| Piece | Format | Deps |
| :-- | :-: | --: |
| PdfDisplay | .pdf | 0 |
| SvgDisplay | .svg | 0 |
| JsonDisplay | .json | 0 |

---

### Checklist

- [x] Parse blocks
- [x] Parse inline marks
- [ ] Syntax highlighting
`
